semantic.justification: Original ordered XRelationshipAccess attribute lookup, strict/transitional types, last duplicate external-ID cache, customTarget filtering, URI RETAIN resolution and VBA project/data nesting. Host asynchronous factories bind native constructors; mutable streamTargets fields bind original translation-unit globals. Shared ZIP input binds XStorage; complete UNO services, repair/encryption are not implemented. Whole-module parity stays unverified and DOCX application/UI import/export is not yet established. Native lazy per-stream FastTokenHandler ownership is preserved. Native generated getFastParser lazily owns a synchronous parser and registers all original82 URI bindings once. Original generated code is traced through factoryimpl.py; no threaded/parser service registration is claimed. Package input now returns actual Reference<XInputStream> values over the existing genuine SequenceInputStream and signed Sequence storage, with empty Reference for absent parts. Fragment input ownership, basename fallback and actual resolved-path InputSource feed native XMLFile2UTFConverter through the existing expanded-name SAX backend. OFOPXMLHelper accepts real InputSource. Writer document input returns Reference copies sharing position; local byte-to-XML decoder/getDocumentXml are removed, and parser/input/VBA intermediate/failure owners unwind explicitly. Actual UNO read exceptions caught by XmlFilterBase are destroyed. Short-prefix EOF loss CALC-363/WRITER238 is preserved and directly tested. ZIP remains a browser byte/package binding: complete XStorage/XStream/XRelationshipAccess, input-disconnection lifecycle, generated token/UNO fragment/StringPair services, StorageBase hierarchy, libxml2 parity, native ABI/thread/allocation unwind and full DOCX/XLSX model/filter/worker/UI acceptance remain incomplete. Existing open/save/autosave/recovery policy is preserved.
